events.title: AI Demand Drives London Office Leasing Surge as 158,000 Sq Ft Deal Signed
events.body: Developers report rising demand from AI firms, with Helical and British Land securing major office leases.

events.title: Landlord British Land hikes guidance amid strong demand from AI firms
events.body: The FTSE 100 company saw shares lift higher in early trading on Tuesday as a result.

events.title: Property sector hit as investors bet AI can replace estate agents
events.body: Property companies have been caught up in the AI sell-off as traders bet on chatbots replacing estate agents.
